items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bunk went out there to play with his band. Bunk was supposed to be there the night when he got killed.

ctx.x: Yeah. Bunk went out there to play with his band. Bunk was supposed to be there the night when he got killed. That’s all hearsay.
Right, and his horn got smashed, and he stopped playing, because he couldn’t get another horn.

items.q: Evan Thomas. The Black Eagle Band. It was a helluva band. They used to come to New Orleans occasionally.

ctx.x: Evan Thomas. The Black Eagle Band. It was a helluva band. They used to come to New Orleans occasionally. And Evan Thomas was going out with some cat's old lady. Cats went to the penitentiary and told... It was a freaky thing, like a country club down there, the penitentiary shit, you know...
